description: Needs a SpaceNexus API key with SpaceNexus Research. Look up a space investor's full recorded portfolio from our funding database: counted private rounds, excluded non-private transactions (each labelled), lead count, co-investors and source URLs.

include_excluded.description: Also return non-private transactions left out of the private-funding count.

investor.description: Investor name or slug, e.g. "Founders Fund", "founders-fund", "Seraphim Space".

limit.description: How many portfolio rounds to return (1 to 25).

name: investor_portfolio_lookup
title: Investor portfolio lookup
